title: Exact polynomial scalar division and slicing
objective: Route ZZ[x] and QQ[x] scalar floor division and truncating prefix slices through generated FLINT resources without whole-polynomial serialization, preserving Sage semantics and lifecycle safety with differential and performance coverage.

oracles: SageMath exact polynomial scalar division and slice semantics

handoff.summary: Added generated callee-owned FLINT operations for ZZ[x] scalar floor division, QQ[x] scalar division, and exact-polynomial prefix truncation. Public scalar // and [:stop] paths preserve canonical resources without coefficient serialization. Sage differential, portable fallback, direct host-adapter, closed/wrong/unsealed resource, ASan/UBSan lifecycle, and degree-100000 performance coverage pass.
risks: The exact polynomial resources remain unavailable in Wasm, so portable hosts continue to use the same-source packed fallback.
The native-integration source-size ratchet rises from 515000 to 522000 bytes for four generated declarations and wrappers.
next_steps: Integrate after rebasing generated declaration hashes and shared FFI ratchets onto the current integration branch.
Consider adding non-prefix polynomial slices only after Sage semantics and a suitable FLINT resource operation are specified.
